🛗
1. The Goal
You are trapped with 7 other passengers. Survive random floor hazards all the way to Floor 99.
⚠️
2. Random Doom
Every floor triggers a surprise hazard: Collapsing tiles, Laser sweeps, or Ticking bombs!
🥊
3. Sabotage & Push
Press E or Shift to shove rivals into hazards. Avoid getting pushed off yourself!
🏆
4. Floor 99 Escape
At Floor 99, the Golden Escape Hatch opens. First survivor to leap in wins the crown!
